legendContract.description: Galileo NIMS observations assign red, green and blue to 0.77, 2.25 and 3.66 µm, following the archive guide. This false-color view shows spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. The observations have Minnaert photometric correction; resolution, residual brightness and seams vary. Fixed channel stretches clip extreme values. Gray grid marks areas lacking a valid sample in any selected band.
